nodes.name: technician_booking_status_model.dart
nodes.summary: Data-layer model extending TechnicianBookingStatus that parses booking status JSON from the API and converts it back into the domain entity.

nodes.name: TechnicianBookingStatusModel
nodes.summary: Extends TechnicianBookingStatus with a fromJson factory and toEntity conversion for booking status API payloads.

nodes.name: technician_slot_model.dart
nodes.summary: Data-layer model extending TechnicianSlotEntity that robustly parses heterogeneous slot JSON shapes (varying key names and value types) returned by the backend into a normalized slot representation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private helper methods (_fromMap, _stringForKeys, _firstStringValue, _formatRange) to defensively normalize inconsistent API field naming/casing for time slot data.

nodes.name: TechnicianSlotModel
nodes.summary: Extends TechnicianSlotEntity; parses dynamic/raw JSON slot data with fallback key matching and produces formatted time ranges and entity instances.

nodes.name: _fromMap
nodes.summary: Private constructor helper that extracts slot id, label, start/end time, and formatted slot time from a loosely-typed JSON map using multiple candidate key names.

nodes.name: technician_summary_model.dart
nodes.summary: Data-layer model extending TechnicianSummaryEntity that deserializes technician summary/profile JSON (name, photo, distance, rating) from the API.

nodes.name: TechnicianSummaryModel
nodes.summary: Extends TechnicianSummaryEntity with a fromJson factory parsing technician profile fields and numeric distance/rating values via tryParse.

nodes.name: technician_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Concrete implementation of ITechnicianRepository that delegates to the technician remote data source, mapping raw responses into domain entities for search, slots, appointments, job cards, and custom package operations.

nodes.name: TechnicianRepository
nodes.summary: Implements ITechnicianRepository; wraps ITechnicianRemoteDataSource calls and maps each response to its corresponding domain entity (technicians, slots, appointments, job card packages, custom package items).

nodes.name: searchNearby
nodes.summary: Fetches nearby technicians from the remote data source and maps results to TechnicianSummaryEntity instances.

nodes.name: getAvailableSlots
nodes.summary: Retrieves available time slots for a technician on a given date and maps them to TechnicianSlotEntity.

nodes.name: getAppointments
nodes.summary: Fetches a technician's appointments within a date range filtered by status.

nodes.name: getBookingStatuses
nodes.summary: Retrieves the list of available booking statuses and maps them into TechnicianBookingStatus entities.

nodes.name: updateAppointmentStatus
nodes.summary: Updates the status of a given booking via the remote data source.

nodes.name: createServiceRequest
nodes.summary: Creates a new service request/job card for a vehicle with VIN, mileage, coupon, and estimation flags.

nodes.name: completeServiceRequest
nodes.summary: Marks a service request as completed for a given user.

nodes.name: getJobCardPackages
nodes.summary: Fetches the packages associated with a job card (service request) and maps them to JobCardPackageEntity.

nodes.name: getCustomPackageCategories
nodes.summary: Retrieves available custom package categories for ad-hoc job card item additions.

nodes.name: getCustomPackageItems
nodes.summary: Fetches custom package items for a job card filtered by category.

nodes.name: addCustomPackageItem
nodes.summary: Adds a custom inventory item line to a job card via the remote data source.

nodes.name: deleteCustomPackageItem
nodes.summary: Removes a custom package item line from a job card by its service-request line id.

nodes.name: getJobCardPackageLines
nodes.summary: Fetches the line items for a specific package within a job card.

nodes.name: addPackageToJobCard
nodes.summary: Adds a service package (optionally tied to a campaign line) to a job card.

nodes.name: deletePackageFromJobCard
nodes.summary: Removes a package line from a job card.

nodes.name: postChecklist
nodes.summary: Submits checklist data for a service request against a specific checklist id.

nodes.name: getPackagesOfJobCard
nodes.summary: Retrieves all packages currently attached to a job card.

nodes.name: booking_status.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a technician booking status with label, code, and display color, including helpers for color parsing and a copyWith method.

nodes.name: TechnicianBookingStatus
nodes.summary: Immutable booking status entity with label/code/hexColor, colorValue parsing, copyWith, and a fromRaw factory for constructing from loose inputs.

nodes.name: custom_package_category_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a custom package category with bilingual descriptions and a displayName helper.

nodes.name: CustomPackageCategoryEntity
nodes.summary: Entity holding id and Arabic/English descriptions for a custom package category, with a displayName getter.

nodes.name: custom_package_item_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity for a custom package inventory item with item code, description, type, and inventory item id.

nodes.name: CustomPackageItemEntity
nodes.summary: Simple data class representing a selectable custom package inventory item.

nodes.name: job_card_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a job card (service request) summary with status, dates, branch, technician, customer, and VIN information.

nodes.name: JobCardEntity
nodes.summary: Data class capturing core job card fields such as srNumber, status, open date, branch, technician, customer, and VIN, plus raw payload.

nodes.name: job_card_package_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a service package on a job card including pricing, discounts, taxes, and emergency/custom flags.

nodes.name: JobCardPackageEntity
nodes.summary: Entity describing a package line on a job card with bilingual names, pricing breakdown (price/tax/cost/discount/list price), and a displayName helper.

nodes.name: job_card_package_line_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a single line item within a job card package, including item, pricing, discount, and condition details.

nodes.name: JobCardPackageLineEntity
nodes.summary: Data class capturing line-level pricing fields (price with/without discount, extended price, conditions, fixed price) for a job card package item.

nodes.name: operation_result_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Generic domain entity representing the outcome of a backend operation, carrying success flag, message, code, and type.

nodes.name: OperationResultEntity
nodes.summary: Simple result wrapper used across technician use cases to convey success/failure, message, code, and type from repository operations.

nodes.name: technician_appointment_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Rich domain entity representing a technician's appointment/booking with vehicle, customer, package, status, and pricing details, plus several display-formatting helpers.

nodes.name: TechnicianAppointmentEntity
nodes.summary: Comprehensive appointment entity with booking, vehicle, customer, package, and status fields, plus computed display helpers (displayPlate, displayCar, packageLabel, statusLabel, statusColorValue).

nodes.name: technician_slot_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a bookable technician time slot with id, label, start/end time, and formatted slot time.

nodes.name: TechnicianSlotEntity
nodes.summary: Base entity for a technician availability slot, extended by TechnicianSlotModel for JSON parsing.

nodes.name: technician_summary_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity representing a brief technician summary/profile used in nearby-search results, including name, photo, organization, branch, distance, and rating.

nodes.name: TechnicianSummaryEntity
nodes.summary: Base entity for a technician's summary profile, extended by TechnicianSummaryModel for JSON deserialization.

nodes.name: i_technician_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Abstract repository interface declaring all technician-related operations (search, slots, appointments, job card and custom package management) that the data layer must implement.

nodes.name: ITechnicianRepository
nodes.summary: Abstract contract for technician data operations implemented by TechnicianRepository and consumed by all technician use cases, decoupling domain logic from the data layer.

nodes.name: add_custom_package_item_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that adds a custom inventory item line to a job card by delegating to ITechnicianRepository.addCustomPackageItem.

nodes.name: AddCustomPackageItemUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates the add-custom-package-item business operation, delegating to the injected ITechnicianRepository and returning an OperationResultEntity.

nodes.name: add_package_to_job_card_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that adds a service package to a job card by delegating to ITechnicianRepository.addPackageToJobCard.

nodes.name: AddPackageToJobCardUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates adding a package (optionally tied to a campaign line) to a job card via the repository.

nodes.name: complete_service_request_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that marks a service request as completed via ITechnicianRepository.completeServiceRequest.

nodes.name: CompleteServiceRequestUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates completing a service request for a given srNumber and userId via the repository.

nodes.name: create_job_card_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that creates a new service request/job card via ITechnicianRepository.createServiceRequest.

nodes.name: CreateJobCardUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates job card creation with vehicle/customer details (VIN, mileage, coupon, estimation flag) delegated to the repository.

nodes.name: delete_custom_package_item_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that deletes a custom package item line from a job card via ITechnicianRepository.deleteCustomPackageItem.

nodes.name: DeleteCustomPackageItemUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates removing a custom package item line by id via the repository.

nodes.name: delete_package_from_job_card_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that removes a package line from a job card via ITechnicianRepository.deletePackageFromJobCard.

nodes.name: DeletePackageFromJobCardUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates removing a package line from a job card by packageLineId and userId via the repository.

nodes.name: get_booking_statuses_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that retrieves the list of available booking statuses via ITechnicianRepository.getBookingStatuses.

nodes.name: GetBookingStatusesUseCase
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper delegating booking-status retrieval to the injected repository.

nodes.name: get_custom_package_categories_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that retrieves available custom package categories via ITechnicianRepository.getCustomPackageCategories.

nodes.name: GetCustomPackageCategoriesUseCase
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper delegating custom package category retrieval to the injected repository.

nodes.name: get_custom_package_items_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that retrieves custom package items for a job card and category via ITechnicianRepository.getCustomPackageItems.

nodes.name: GetCustomPackageItemsUseCase
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper delegating custom package item retrieval (filtered by job card and category) to the injected repository.

nodes.name: get_customer_appointments_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that retrieves a customer's upcoming service appointments, delegating to the upcoming_service feature's remote data source rather than the technician repository directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Despite living in the technician feature's use_case folder, this class depends on UpcomingServiceRemoteDataSourceImpl from the separate upcoming_service feature, indicating cross-feature coupling.

nodes.name: GetCustomerAppointmentsUseCase
nodes.summary: Encapsulates fetching a customer's upcoming services by delegating to UpcomingServiceRemoteDataSourceImpl.getUpcomingServices, returning UpcomingServiceModel entries.
